# Menu

Menu markup with horizontal, vertical and recursively nested navigation examples.

## PGS

- `menu`: identifies the menu element used by Menu.

## PGS generated by JavaScript

- `_menu-buttonIcon`: the toggle inserted after the link of every item that has a submenu; it looks and sits the same whichever behaviour it drives.
- `_menu-accordion`: marks an item whose submenu opens in place rather than floating, which is every item of a vertical menu and every level below the first of a horizontal one.

## PGS Options

- `menuHorizontal`: identifies the menuHorizontal element used by Menu.
- `menuVertical`: identifies the menuVertical element used by Menu.
- `menuIconOnlyCurrent`: displays link icons only when the link has an active aria-current value.
- `menuShort`: compacts adjacent menu links by overlapping their horizontal spacing.

## PGS States

- `open`: identifies the open element used by Menu.

## JavaScript API

- `pgs.menu.init(root)`: initializes matching elements within the specified root.
- `pgs.menu.api(element)`: returns the instance associated with the specified initialized element.
- `instance.refresh()`: refreshes the component and returns its updated instance.

## Related elements

### PGS

- `button`: styles a menu link, now that the menu no longer does it itself.
- `flexRow`: lays the top-level list out as a row, so a long menu can be measured against the space it has.
- `icon`: draws the glyphs this example shows; see Icon for the whole set.

### PGS Options

- `buttonText`: the appearance a navigation link takes, whatever the menu's direction; see Button for the whole set of variants.
- `wrap`: lets that row break onto a second line instead of overflowing.
- `icon-circle`: a plain disc, standing in for a section icon.
- `icon-circleInfo`: the information mark.
- `icon-sliders`: the sliders glyph, standing in for a section icon.

### Other

- `dropdown`: uses the related dropdown component or utility in this example.
- `dropdown-button`: uses the related dropdown-button component or utility in this example.
- `dropdown-content`: uses the related dropdown-content component or utility in this example.
- `buttonNohover`: disables hover behavior on menu buttons generated at runtime.
- `dropdownPosition`: set by Menu at runtime on the li it turns into a dropdown, to place the first-level floating submenu.

## CSS Variables

- `--menu-gap-column`
- `--menu-gap-row`

## Output

Horizontal and vertical menu examples, including recursively nested submenus.

## Example

## Examples

### Horizontal menu

Top-level navigation arranged horizontally, with one nested submenu.

```html
<nav pgs="menu" pgs-option="menuHorizontal" aria-label="Menu orizzontale">
    <ul pgs="flexRow" pgs-option="wrap">
        <li>
            <a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/" aria-current="page">
                <i pgs="icon" pgs-option="icon-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>Home</span>
            </a>
        </li>
        <li>
            <a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services">
                <i pgs="icon" pgs-option="icon-sliders" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>Services</span>
            </a>
            <ul>
                <li><a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                <li><a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services/two">Second service</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li>
            <a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/about">
                <i pgs="icon" pgs-option="icon-circleInfo" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>about</span>
            </a>
            <ul>
                <li><a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                <li>
                    <a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services/two">Second service</a>
                    <ul>
                        <li><a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                        <li><a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services/two">Second service</a></li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>
</nav>
```

### Vertical menu

Vertical navigation with recursively nested submenus, showing icons only on the active link.

```html

            </a>
        </li>
        <li>
            <a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services">

            </a>
            <ul>
                <li><a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                <li><a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services/two">Second service</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li>
            <a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/about">
                <i pgs="icon" pgs-option="icon-circleInfo" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>about</span>
            </a>
            <ul>
                <li><a pgs="button" pgs-option="buttonText" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
```
